_about: Public-domain Robert W. Patterson, pastor of the Second Presbyterian Church of Chicago, for the Word Hoard: three of his sermons, The Place where God Records his Name, A Sermon on Prayer for Rulers, and Elements of Christianity that tend to secure its Diffusion. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 122 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

patterson-gods-name: The place where God records his name : a discourse, at the dedication of the Second Presbyterian Church, on Friday evening, Jan. 24, 1851, at Chicago, Ill (Chicago : Published by S.C. Griggs & Co., 1851)
patterson-prayer-for-rulers: A sermon on prayer for rulers, delivered in the Second Presbyterian Church in Chicago, on Sabbath morning, June 8, 1856 (Chicago : S.C. Griggs and Co., 1856)
patterson-elements: Elements of Christianity that tend to secure its diffusion and universal prevalence : a sermon, before the American Board of Commissioners for Foreign Missions, at the meeting in Philadelphia, Pa. October 2, 1859 (Press of T. R. Marvin, 1859)
